newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica mobile clients up 153 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica mobile clients up 153 pct in '96.

text.p: Telefonica's mobile customers grew 153 percent in 1996, the firm said on Friday.
The number of clients for the mobile division was 2,345,645 at the end of 1996 versus 928,995 at December 1995.
Telefonica's market share in Spain is now 80 percent.
The firm said income from this business division was almost 260 billion pesetas, up 129 percent from 1995.
Income at the international division rose 19 percent to 353.77 billion pesetas, accounting for 15 percent of the group's total income.
Telefonica said these results were depressed by the devaluation of the Chilean peso and the Peruvian sol.
